notes.title: Demo Update – New Level + Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We’ve rolled out a new update for the demo! This patch tackles a number of bugs and also introduces a brand-new fast-paced level. It’s completely optional, but we hope you’ll give it a try and have fun with it.
Highlights of this update:
New Level: Intro City → Grass – a fast-paced experience added to the demo.

UI Improvements: Adjusted interface on entry for a smoother start.

Better Transitions: Cleaner fade-ins and improved loading flow.

Silver Nuggets: Now rewarded when re-doing an already completed cave puzzle.

Rail System Update: Adjustments made, though speed is still tied to FPS. If rails feel too fast, set your FPS to Max 60 in the settings menu and back out to apply.

Virtual Cameras: Now highlight which areas you’re moving into.

And More: Several smaller improvements under the hood, with plenty more on the way!

Thanks for checking out the demo and sharing your feedback—it really helps shape the game as we continue development!

notes.title: Wishlist now! Capri Care in the works
notes.content:
Since a small project in September of 2024 this project has grown quite a bit up until now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438557/8476c1acdd56b9923e79f0290d4eba8196040f5d.jpg

Several features have already been added to the game 'albeit needing polish'.

These features include


 Capri Consumables
 Creature Consumables
 Birth
 Rebirth
 Breeding
 Individual Stats for overall Capri performance
 Color Modification
 Patterns
 Dig Puzzles
 Fly Puzzles
 Tree Growth
 Plant Growth
 Fishing
 Creature Capture Mechanics
 Capri Creation through Incubation
 Racing
 Tug of War
 Treasure Hunt
 Matching Game
 The first 2 Gardens
 The first 2 Open Area
 Area Requirements

Calculated Behaviors affected by:
 Allegiance
 Happiness
 Hunger
 Personality Trait

Capri Box allowing management of:
 Cosmetics
 Capri Garden Location
 Return Capri
 Viewing Stats


and more to come!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438557/fda6ac2dfaaed13a37da58b2ca3bac67cbc68d92.png

Currently I am working on implementing more minigames for the 2nd Area in the game, getting some more graphical assets and creating more cosmetics.

But in the meantime the game is available for wishlist and as more and more development is done I will do my best to keep the news rolling.

Thank you for visiting, 
Thank you for wishlisting if you did
and thank you for reading!
